name: Edifier Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Edifier Technology Co., Ltd. designs, produces, and sells audio equipment in China. The company also engages in research and development, production and sales of home audio, professional audio, car audio, headphones; microphones; bookshelf and monitor speakers; studio monitors and PA speakers; speakers for TV and home theater; subwoofers; gaming headphones and earphones; open-ear; and on-ear and over-ear headphones. Edifier Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
